description: Source code for ProgressReporter and ProgressContext classes in Spark Structured Streaming, responsible for tracking and reporting streaming query progress, metrics, and stateful operator statistics.

classes.name: ProgressReporter
classes.description: Class responsible for reporting streaming query progress and latency metrics, maintaining recent progress updates, and posting events about query idleness and progress.

classes.name: ProgressContext
classes.description: Abstract class for tracking metrics and progress during a streaming batch execution, including source offsets, execution stats, and final progress reporting.

classes.name: ProgressContext.ExecutionStats
classes.description: Case class encapsulating execution statistics such as input rows, state operator metrics, event time stats, and output rows.

methods.name: updateProgress
methods.description: Updates the progress buffer with new progress, posts a progress event, and logs the update.

methods.name: updateIdleness
methods.description: Records an idle state event if no data has been processed within a configured interval.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp in milliseconds into ISO8601 string in UTC.

methods.name: startTrigger
methods.description: Begins tracking a new trigger, resetting relevant timestamps and offsets.

methods.name: recordTriggerOffsets
methods.description: Records the start, end, and latest offsets for a trigger.

methods.name: finishNoExecutionTrigger
methods.description: Finalizes a trigger that did not execute a batch, updating progress accordingly.

methods.name: finishTrigger
methods.description: Finalizes a trigger after batch execution, updating progress and metrics.

methods.name: constructNewProgress
methods.description: Constructs a StreamingQueryProgress object from current metrics and offsets.
